nonblocking_judgement_notes.detail: Dynamic concatenated/variable keys still pass, as the explicit static-only contract permits. Do not claim data-flow/obfuscation/eval/sandbox coverage; this is not an unclosed direct-alias or static-literal bypass.

Every exact Identifier is rejected, including harmless labels/local bindings and non-global properties/getter/setter keys. Intentional fail-closed tradeoff. Similar names, normal string values and __webpack_require__ are preserved.

Assertions assume normal Python (not -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE), and standalone sdk is optional. Current CI uses normal python3 and supplies the fixed SDK; native fields make omission visible. For future reuse, explicitly reject optimized Python and require SDK for a full-native-gate claim.

SHA lambda/runpy-loaded verifier functions and compact product validator names reduce discoverability. A small shared host-verifier module could help future reuse. Compact product names are expressly authorized for the unchanged <49152-byte budget; neither point is a hard blocker.

No candidate APP/HAP exists in this repository. Actual candidate signed bytes/CMS/profile/chain and exact native SDK parser remain external CI gates. Host/control-flow tests do not prove FIT3 firmware/installation, UI, heap/image release or Wear Engine E2E.
